name: Dallan Heart
source:
A friendly and charismatic wolf from a prestigious, wealthy family, both in assets and in members.
Unfortunately, he's seen as the black sheep of that said family.

The leader of the Defender's Shard and the most respected student of Lakonia Acedemy.
He often forgets to take breaks and ends up overworking, in an attempt to prove himself.
He is kind, loyal and defending people is his driving fire.
